purpose: Square app icon for meshly: website favicon, Apple touch icon (iPhone / iPad home screen), GitHub social avatar
reference: Use exactly the same logo mark as in the meshly banner generated earlier in this conversation: the hexagonal lowercase "m" built from connected nodes, with the neon cyan to magenta gradient. Reproduce that mark faithfully; do not invent a different one.

format.shape: full-bleed square; do not draw rounded corners, a device frame or a drop shadow around the canvas (iOS and browsers apply their own mask)
format.safe_area: keep the whole mark inside the central 70% of the canvas so it survives the iOS corner mask and tiny favicon sizes

composition.subject: only the logo mark, perfectly centered, filling about 60-65% of the canvas width
composition.background: deep near-black navy to deep purple, a soft radial glow behind the mark and a few faint stars; no grid, no scene, no servers, no planets

style.genre: cyberpunk meets deep space, matching the banner
style.rendering: crisp vector-like edges with a soft neon glow; strong silhouette and thick strokes so the mark stays recognizable at 32x32 and 16x16 pixels; high contrast

constraints.text: no text at all: no wordmark, no letters other than the "m" formed by the mark itself
avoid: rounded-corner tile or app-icon frame drawn into the image
thin hairline details that disappear at small sizes
